title: The Lord is My Salvation
lyrics_original: The grace of God has reached for me
And pulled me from the raging sea
And I am safe on this solid ground
The Lord is my salvation
I will not fear when darkness falls
His strength will help me scale these walls
I’ll see the dawn of the rising sun
The Lord is my salvation
Who is like the Lord our God?
Strong to save, faithful in love
My debt is paid and the vict’ry won
The Lord is my salvation
My hope is hidden in the Lord
He flow’rs each promise of His Word
When winter fades I know spring will come
The Lord is my salvation
In times of waiting, times of need
When I know loss, when I am weak
I know His grace will renew these days
The Lord is my salvation
Who is like the Lord our God?
Strong to save, faithful in love
My debt is paid and the vict’ry won
The Lord is my salvation
And when I reach my final day
He will not leave me in the grave
But I will rise,
He will call me home
The Lord is my salvation
Who is like the Lord our God?
Strong to save, faithful in love
My debt is paid and the vict’ry won
The Lord is my salvation
Glory be to God the Father
Glory be to God the Son
Glory be to God the Spirit
The Lord is our salvation
Glory be to God the Father
Glory be to God the Son
Glory be to God the Spirit
The Lord is our salvation
The Lord is our salvation
The Lord is our salvation

bible_verses.english: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and established my steps.
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yahweh, even Yah, is my strength and my song; and he has become my salvation.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for reaching down in Your mercy and rescuing me when I was sinking. When fear and darkness surround me, help me to remember that You are my solid ground and my strength. Grant me the courage to face every obstacle, knowing that You are faithful and strong to save. I place my trust completely in You today, my light and my salvation. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the storms of life threaten to overwhelm us, God’s grace reaches down into the deepest waters to pull us to safety. He does not leave us to struggle alone; instead, He sets our feet firmly on the solid ground of His unshakeable love. Even in the darkest nights, His strength gives us hope for the coming dawn. As you worship today, declare with confidence that your security rests safely in the hands of the Lord, your faithful Savior.
